conclusion: No disposable clean worktree or obsolete duplicate cache. Same active warm cache and Rust/comparison outputs retained; all dirty source, validation evidence and recovery backups preserved. No new worktree or cache. Latest proof batch backed up remotely and temporary backup index removed.
discipline: Check disk before worktree creation/heavy builds; target 100 GiB free and projected 50 GiB floor. Review cleanup after every batch/PR/stop. One warm build cache by default; aggregate CPU/memory/I/O budgets across agents; OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=2 LEAN_NUM_THREADS=2 for validation. Never clean other projects. Every worktree/cache has an owner and purpose; delegated tasks include cleanup; agent count does not increase the shared budget.
